slides.title: Marks [[dekho]]
slides.note: Aarav aur Meera **dono 95**. Dono first? Phir Kabir kaunsa? 🤔

slides.title: Teeno [[ek saath]]
slides.code:
SELECT name, marks,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER w AS rn,
 RANK() OVER w AS rnk,
 DENSE_RANK() OVER w AS drnk
FROM students
WINDOW w AS
  (ORDER BY marks DESC);
slides.note: **WINDOW w** = OVER ek baar likho (MySQL 8 / Postgres). SQL Server 2022+

slides.title: [[Result]] ka farq
slides.note: Kabir: RANK mein **3** (2 skip), DENSE_RANK mein **2** 👀

slides.title: Olympics [[logic]]
slides.note: RANK = sports style, DENSE_RANK = **salary levels** style

slides.title: Kab [[kaunsa]]?
slides.note: "2nd highest salary" ke liye **DENSE_RANK = 2** filter karo 🎯

slides.wrong:
Nth highest ke liye
WHERE rnk = 2  -- RANK()
slides.right:
Nth highest ke liye
WHERE drnk = 2  -- DENSE_RANK()
slides.why: Tie ke baad RANK **2 skip** karta → result khaali 💀
